assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mushoku-tensei:cliff@light-novel#character-model, the canonical Cliff bounded reconstruction model (generation V1, revision 1.5) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked Japanese light novels V01-V15, with direct Cliff grounds in V09-V11 and V13-V15 and earlier admitted appearances used only as context. The model routes its observations to an evidence index, the shared state and readiness ledger, per-volume deep readings and checkpoint syntheses, none of which is curated on this subject or used as evidence here. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only. No web novel, later light-novel volume, adaptation, performed voice, reception or remembered-future material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's fifteen selectors MT-CM-ST01 to ST15: the V09 opening retrospect, Rudeus's arrival and the rescue, the disclosed attraction and care promise, and months of research with the uncertain lead (ST01-ST04); V10 investigation and marriage advice, the Elinalise family disclosure, and the layered-circle collaboration (ST05-ST07); V11 prototype improvement with the proposal before a cure, and the church-trainee counsel to Norn (ST08-ST09); V13 collaborative prosthetic work with the dependence critique, and the modest home and wedding (ST10-ST11); V14 duty-based confrontation with voluntary travel and charity, and the chosen reward, escape role, healing and uncontrolled new eye (ST12-ST13); and V15 armor-systems collaboration and the pregnancy information with the corrected suspicion (ST14-ST15). ST01 is revealed retrospect, V12 supplies no selector, the V15 reported alternative-future death is not a state, no earlier state acquires later knowledge, and nothing after V15 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives five conditional rules (MT-CM-001 to 005) for persistence at accessible study or an important unresolved project, partial revision of an expected hierarchy under accumulating observed deeds while dislike persists, sharp or physical confrontation when a valued person is disparaged, acceptance of a loved person's continuing constraint with an ambitious care promise and research, and need- or role-conditioned openness (thanks after rescue, qualified listening, a request to a disliked but useful peer), each with a countercase, an alternative and a discriminating test, plus an explanatory section on diligence held together with an expectation of exceptional achievement. Rules 001, 004 and 005 carry located extensions through V15, but rule 002 has no comparable hierarchy reversal after V10, rule 003 has no equivalent trigger after V09 apart from a verbal V14 near analog, mechanism confidence is moderate and all calibration is retrospective under disclosed franchise familiarity, so B is not supported. Falsifiable rules with countercases and an explicitly rejected 'boastful fraud' reading exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

Fifteen selectors run from the V09 opening retrospect (ST01, marked REVEALED_NOT_NEW) to the V15 pregnancy information (ST15), each with knowledge, goals, limits and a change kind, and the model bars specific leakage: later relationship knowledge does not enter ST01, the narrator's correction of his reading of Zanoba's ambition is not something he secretly holds, accepting the reported curse is not mastery of its mechanism, and the V13 future fidelity and lifespan stay untested. The selectors are one-line table cells, transitions are owned by the uncurated shared state ledger, V12 supplies no state and his earlier admitted appearances are context only, so B is not supported; a sequence with stated change kinds and per-state knowledge limits exceeds an undifferentiated profile, so D is not supported.

The model characterizes his written speech only in prose: declarative, evaluative and confident, yet including deliberate thanks after a rescue, a qualified listening offer and an explicit request for information (V09:003/005/018), an abrasive opening to pastoral counsel that hurts its recipient (V11:033-034) and a candid rebuke (V13:006), and it warns that he must not become a stock boast in every turn. It quotes no wording, self-reference or ending and excludes performed voice, so D is not supported; the register and several located speech acts are affirmatively characterized with a countercase, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore them. This is the claim closest to D.

Located ordinary items include disciplined elementary study and irritation at noise (V09), months of unsuccessful research (V09:018), continued schooling (V13), a modest home and wedding with partner financing declined (V13:019) and feeding an unknown beggar (V14:017). The model states that family negotiation, long-term household conduct and private leisure preferences remain insufficiently evidenced and gives each item in a clause, so C is not supported; several distinct located ordinary acts across four volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model locates differentiated, countercased responses across recipients: Elinalise as the person he chose to love, whose curse terms he accepts (V09:005), whose family disclosure renews his commitment (V10:014), to whom he proposes before any cure (V11:017), whose financial help he declines (V13:019), on whose guidance he comes to depend (V14) and whose pregnancy prompts a suspicion he corrects (V15:015), with her intervention able to calm him and her choice remaining hers; Rudeus as a disliked peer whose observed ability he accepts (V09:001), whom he asks for information (V09:018), whose work he comes to recognize (V10:021) and whom he rebukes for an acquisition framing (V13:006); Zanoba, whose goal inspires him through a mistaken analogy (V09:001), who strikes him (V10:005) and who becomes a collaborator; Norn, whom he counsels after noticing her distress and who objects to his opening (V11:033-034); Nanahoshi, for whom he asks help as his reward (V14:017); and the V14 host he confronts (V14:012). B is not supported because most responses are clauses, the evidence centers on Elinalise and family negotiation is unknown; differentiated responses toward several attested recipients exceed a single relational sketch, so D is not supported.

The model locates some inner material: the narrator renders and corrects his reading of Zanoba's ambition (V09:001), the narrator qualifies a political future fantasy in the V11 counsel (ST09), he deliberately interrupts defensiveness to thank a rescuer (V09:003) and he needs reassurance during collaboration (V10:021). The V13-V15 sections say D0 covers interiority, but the model locates no extended focalized passage, presents pride inhibiting a request for instruction and his regulation as inferred transition mechanisms rather than rendered thought, and keeps mechanism confidence moderate, so C is not supported; narrator-rendered thoughts and located inner states in more than one volume exceed a single mention, so E is not supported. This is the claim closest to C.

Rule 003 is located only at V09:003/018: a first strike against a group despite unfavorable odds and a later insult conflict moderated by Elinalise's intervention or redirected curiosity, with courage, proportion and practical success kept distinct. The model scores no equivalent trigger in V10, V11, V13 or V15; being struck by Zanoba (V10:005) is a different role, the V13 rebuke (V13:006) is verbal perspective-taking and the V14 duty-based confrontation of a host who refuses aid (V14:012) is a verbal near analog limited by Elinalise. A one-volume trigger with only verbal later analogs does not support C; located physical and verbal confrontations with countercases across three volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported. This is the claim closest to C.

The model locates morally weighted choices and stated positions: defending a valued person's dignity, accepting a burdensome condition of a partner whose choice remains hers (V09:005), duty as a supported motive beside affection (V10:014), role-based help that can still hurt (V11:033-034), a critique of household dependence and acquisition framing (V13:006), declining partner financing (V13:019), a duty-based confrontation over refused aid, unsolicited charity and asking help for Nanahoshi as his own reward (V14:012/017). Disproportionate confrontation and idealization coexist with these. The model shows positions and acts but no weighing of competing goods, and it neither endorses his social hierarchy nor reduces his acts to status seeking, so C is not supported; repeated located choices with countercases across four volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported. This is the claim closest to C.

The model mentions a celebration after the V10 collaboration (ST07) but locates no humorous or playful instance and no function for play. Absence of located evidence is not treated as a trait or an inability.

One curated item: a compact model (revision 1.5) covering his V09-V11 and V13-V15 appearances through five rules, fifteen selectors and twenty-one retrospective checks, with observations routed to an evidence index, a shared state ledger, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses that are not curated on his row. The model declares itself BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with no clean holdout, uses earlier admitted appearances only as context and names family negotiation, household conduct, leisure, political leadership and broad therapeutic competence as unwarranted or insufficiently evidenced, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of every admitted volume in which he is a direct subject exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates affirmative limits and corrections: a spell that fails because the object is not a spirit (V10:004-005), a curse cure that remains unachieved through V15, the narrator's correction of his political analogy (V09:001), a first strike that does not demonstrate practical competence (V09:003), an abrasive opening that hurts Norn and draws her objection (V11:033-034), an admitted travel limit (V11:017), an identification eye that is uncontrolled and needs guidance (V14:019-022), a paternity suspicion corrected by Elinalise (V15:015) and technical successes that depend on several contributors; it also rejects both a universal pride barrier and universal humility. Each limit is a clause and calibration is retrospective with prior familiarity, so B is not supported; located failures and corrections across five volumes exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

Each selector is bound to a volume and an observation section (S125 to S244), ST01 is marked as revealed retrospect rather than new action, later relationship knowledge and the narrator's correction are barred from earlier states, and the V15 reported alternative-future death (V15:002) is explicitly separated so that no false fatal state enters. B is not supported because selectors are one-line labels, no ages or dates are given, transitions are held by an uncurated state ledger and V12 leaves no state; D is not supported because knowledge is bounded per state rather than given as a loose period.

scenario_readiness.note: The model characterizes his register only in prose (declarative, evaluative and confident, with located thanks, a qualified offer, an explicit request, an abrasive pastoral opening and a candid rebuke) and quotes no wording; it excludes performed voice and warns against a stock boast. CONDITIONAL would generate speech from a prose register description; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the characterized register and located speech acts.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any single named selector MT-CM-ST01 to ST15 between the V09 opening retrospect and the V15 pregnancy information, with that state's knowledge only; nothing from V12 as a state, nothing after V15, no later knowledge in an earlier state and no state from the V15 reported alternative future.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their state-specific relation: Elinalise as chosen partner and later wife; Rudeus as disliked peer, information source, collaborator and recipient of rebuke; Zanoba as inspiration, assailant and collaborator; Norn as recipient of church-trainee counsel; Nanahoshi as research subject and beneficiary of his reward request; the V14 host; and the V14 beggar.
setting_constraints: The school, research, church-trainee, household and V14-V15 travel and armor-work settings of the Japanese light novels V09-V11 and V13-V15
No modern setting, political leadership, family negotiation, long-term household conduct or private leisure
No clinical diagnosis, therapeutic expertise, invariant temper or invariant humility
Near-analog situations only; materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model permits D0 represented behavior and only D1 near-analog extension within named contexts, keeps all admitted domains BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL, requires abstention in unsupported contexts and calls political leadership, broad therapeutic competence and complete adult domestic reconstruction unwarranted; the confrontation trigger is untested after V09 and calibration is retrospective under prior familiarity. CONDITIONAL would extend a near-analog license to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

Located ordinary social material is a set of clauses (study, irritation at noise, conversation, a modest wedding, charity to a beggar), and the model calls family negotiation, long-term household conduct and private leisure insufficiently evidenced. CONDITIONAL would build ordinary social behavior from summary clauses; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located items.

The evidence locates stated moral positions and acts (duty as motive, the dependence critique, declined financing, charity and the reward request) together with disproportionate confrontation and idealization, but no weighing of competing goods. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the model does not show; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located choices.

conditions: Only his commitment and care decisions toward Elinalise in an attested state as near analogs: responding to new information about her constraint or history, choosing to continue the commitment under limited resources, offering feasible support instead of unsafe accompaniment, and correcting a mistaken suspicion.
Elinalise's motives, consent and choices are not generated; her choice remains hers and his promise gives him no authority over her.
No sexual or intimate content, no ordinary courtship or domestic routine, no curse cure, and no fidelity or lifespan outcome is generated.
The selected state's knowledge only; output is behavior described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: Rule 004 is his most consistently extended rule: acceptance of the curse terms (V09:005), renewed commitment after the family disclosure (V10:014), a proposal before any cure (V11:017), the modest marriage with financing declined (V13:019), continued partnership with new dependence on her guidance (V14) and the pregnancy suspicion corrected (V15:015), with countercases (romantic idealization and pride as contributing motives, her intervention calming him, her independent choice). Readiness is conditional because the model calls long-term household conduct and complete adult domestic reconstruction unwarranted, gives no access to Elinalise's motives and leaves fidelity and lifespan untested. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a relationship model; NOT_READY would deny the commitment behavior the model extends in every admitted volume.

conditions: Only attested research-collaboration and church-trainee situations as near analogs: persisting at an unresolved project, admitting the limits of his knowledge, asking a useful peer for information, contributing a specialized element to shared work and offering role-based help to a distressed acquaintance.
Behavior only: no spell, array, device, armor, healing or curse-cure content or result is generated, and success is not inferred from effort.
Counsel keeps its fallibility: an abrasive opening, a recipient's objection and inferences about the recipient's mind remain possible, and no therapeutic expertise or leadership is implied.
The selected state's knowledge only; output is behavior described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: Research collaboration is extended in every admitted volume: persistence on the cure, artifact inquiry and layered-circle work (V10:004-005/021), device improvement (V11:013), prosthetic and array contributions (V13:003/013/031), the identification eye and healing (V14:017-022) and armor systems (V15:014-015/019), with countercases of diagnostic failure, reliance on several contributors and an unachieved cure. Church-trainee counsel is located twice (V11:033-034, V13:006) with its fallibility. Readiness is conditional because technical content is not admitted, counsel rests on two episodes with inferred recipient minds and leadership is excluded. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a procedure; NOT_READY would deny the domain the model extends in every admitted volume.

known_limits.statement: Persistent research, a partial device and working technical contributions do not establish that Elinalise's curse is cured; through V15 the cure remains unachieved and the reported theory remains qualified hearsay.

Pride can inhibit asking for instruction and can delay acceptance of a peer, yet he does revise specific judgments under observed deeds; accepting ability is not liking its possessor, and a revision need not be globally accurate, as the corrected Zanoba analogy shows.
Defending a valued person can be rash or disproportionate; courage, proportion and practical success are not equivalent, and the confrontation trigger is tested physically only in V09.
Elinalise retains independent choice; his promise creates a commitment for him, not authority over her, and an idealized first impression gives no reliable access to her motives.
His role-based counsel can be useful and still hurtful or mistaken; it is not broad therapeutic expertise, and his account of Norn's situation remains inference about her mind.
The V15 reported alternative-future rescue and death concern another branch; they are not his present state or outcome.

All twenty-one checks are retrospective fits with disclosed prior franchise familiarity, not clean holdouts or numerical prediction scores; scene confidence is high and mechanism confidence moderate, and no domain is DOMAIN_READY.

The evidence index, shared state ledger, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses to which the model routes its observations are not curated on this subject, so its observation locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
Family negotiation, long-term household conduct, private leisure preferences and unfamiliar institutional leadership are not established; this is a gap, not evidence of incapacity.
His earlier admitted appearances are context only, V12 supplies no state and nothing after V15 is in evidence; earlier and later states, knowledge and outcomes are not assessed.
No humorous or playful instance is located, so humor and play are not assessed; this is a gap, not evidence that he lacks humor.
